title: a11y: use radio-group ARIA for Plan/Act mode toggle
body:
## Description

Screen reader users previously could not determine which mode (Plan/Act) was active — the toggle used `role="switch"` on two independent divs without proper grouping or focus management.

## Changes
- SwitchContainer role: `radiogroup` with `aria-label`
- Individual labels role: `radio` with proper `aria-checked`
- ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard navigation between options
- `tabIndex` management (only active option focusable)
- `aria-label` on each radio for screen reader context

Closes #4932
